changelog: Fix: 2026_09_15_0001 (v3.11.0) created trade_journal and trade_journal_actions without the utf8mb4/utf8mb4_general_ci charset every other table in this schema uses — both fell back to the server default (latin1_swedish_ci on live), which would mangle or reject non-Latin1 characters. Migration 2026_09_15_0002 converts both tables; safe because both were still empty. Reproduced and verified the fix against a real database, including confirming both foreign keys survive the conversion

Fix: TradeController::getAll() had no defense against trade_journal being unavailable — a missing or broken table threw an uncaught exception that fataled the entire trade list, not just the journal portion. The journal queries are now wrapped defensively (tried once per request, not once per trade) and fall back to an empty trade_journal per trade instead of taking get_trades down
Process: added a migration-writing checklist item to CLAUDE.md — every CREATE TABLE must specify DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci explicitly, so this specific mistake doesn't recur
